# QS-CFW-1730-97 - Quality specification - valve body CFW-1730-97 (F316)  
Revision: Rev B (This revision supersedes Rev A)  
Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-1730-97

Scope
- Defines minimum quality requirements, acceptance criteria, and inspection methods for valve body CFW-1730-97 (CFW-1730-97) manufactured from F316 in Plant P2.

Requirements table
| Feature | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---:|---|
| Material | F316 per procurement specification | Conformant mill cert required |
| Hardness | 27-33 HRC. | All production pieces shall fall within range |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.09 mm. | Measured per drawing control; reject if outside tolerance |
| Maximum forging weight | 148.1 kg. | Do not exceed during blank selection and forging charge |

Inspection method
- Verification shall be performed on representative samples from each lot using calibrated equipment traceable to laboratory standards.
- Hardness: test locations per drawing; report values and show compliance to 27-33 HRC.
- Dimensional: measure bore diameter using appropriate gauging; results must meet ±0.09 mm. tolerance.
- Weight: confirm forging blank weight does not exceed 148.1 kg. before processing.
- Records: inspection results, equipment IDs, operator initials, and disposition shall be entered into the document control system for retention.

Nonconformance handling
- Any item found outside the stated acceptance criteria in the Requirements table is nonconforming.
- Segregate nonconforming items from production stock pending disposition.
- Nonconforming items shall be evaluated for repair, rework, or scrap; disposition must be documented and approved by Quality.
- For repeated nonconformances, initiate corrective action per site procedures and document root cause and containment.
- Re-inspection after approved disposition is required to verify conformance to the listed requirements prior to release.
